name: Amumu
notes: Opening: Despair (W) is toggled on at t=0 and left on for the whole fight (its mana-per-second cost is not modeled, matching the dossier's note that nothing here binds inside a 15 s fight); its first tick is assumed to land at t=0 (gen.W.tickOffsetS), then every 0.5 s.

Curse of the Sad Mummy (R) is cast at t=0 as the opening cast (its own damage lands at the end of its 0.25 s cast time), Bandage Toss (Q) is cast immediately and again whenever a charge is available, and Tantrum (E) is cast on cooldown throughout.

Bandage Toss is assumed to start the fight with both charges stocked (gen.Q.startCharges = 2), the common reading for a champion entering combat rather than from a completely fresh recall; its per-rank recharge time is assumed to interpolate linearly between the wiki's stated endpoints (16 at rank 1, 12 at rank 5) since only the endpoints are given (gen.Q.rechargeS).

Bandage Toss's forced basic attack when the dash lands is not modeled as a separate attack instance (only the usual 0.25 s cast lockout is applied): Amumu already attacks continuously on his own schedule between casts, so this keeps the attack timeline simple without double-counting a hit.

Cursed Touch's 10% bonus true damage on incoming pre-mitigation magic damage is applied consistently the way the wiki documents it for Curse of the Sad Mummy: each of Amumu's own magic hits (Q, a Despair tick, E, R) is amplified only if the target was already marked with Curse from an earlier hit, and only afterward does that hit itself (re)apply the 3 s mark; a basic attack deals no magic damage in this kit so it only (re)applies the mark, never triggers the bonus itself.
Tantrum's passive physical-damage reduction and its cooldown reduction from being hit by an on-hit attack are ignored: the stationary dummy never attacks, so neither ever applies.
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing here would actually stall casting inside a 15 s fight at level 16.

the wiki only gives the rank-1 and rank-5 recharge times (16 and 12); the three middle ranks are assumed to step down by 1s per rank like Amumu's other by-rank lists
the wiki does not say whether Despair's first tick lands at the moment of toggling on or 0.5s later; the first-tick-immediate reading is assumed
